payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each student i, to minimize prior failures, greedily select the smallest previous times that fit into remaining time M - t_i, using a frequency array for O(1) access per time value.
payload.rationale: The solution directly implements a greedy choice: always pick the smallest available exam times to maximize count of previous students passing. This is a classic greedy sorting/selection, not an exchange argument. The frequency array is just an optimization for bounded times.
